payload.headline: Estimated leak of 140 m3/h on the Government main
payload.explanation: The Government District main is losing about 140 m3/h. Send a pipe repair crew now.
probableCauses: Pipe burst on the main segment

predictedImpact.text: Pressure in the Government District falls below 2.5 bar within 10 minutes.

recommendedAction.text: Isolate the segment and send a pipe repair crew

breakdown.label: Service disruption, zone-gov
breakdown.cause: 2,500 EGP/h for a government zone × 6 h

reasons.text: Pressure fell from 3.8 to 2.1 bar in 4 minutes
Inflow is 140 m3/h higher than outflow
Neighbouring sensors read normal, so this is not a sensor fault
Pump P-04 draw is up 12% as it compensates
